compute.cost_note: local and offline; zip/OPF parsing plus HTML-to-text per spine document; no network

do_not_use_when: the books are .mobi or .azw3 (reported and skipped; convert to EPUB first)
the books span several registers; one --register applies to every book in a run, so split mixed-register libraries into separate runs

examples.cmd: python3 plugins/setec-voiceprint/scripts/acquire_epub.py ebooks/ --impostor-for my_fiction_persona --register literary_horror --consent-status fair_use_research --segment chapter --min-words 500
examples.description: Chapter-level literary-horror impostor pool from a folder of ebooks

inputs.target: directory of .epub files, or a single .epub

purpose: ingest local EPUB ebooks (a directory or a single .epub) into the private impostor pool, or as identity-baseline entries with --corpus-role, reading OPF metadata and the reading-order spine into one entry per chapter (--segment chapter) or per book; multi-author directories get one persona per book author.
use_when: building a register-matched impostor pool from ebooks you hold locally
ingesting your own published ebooks as an identity baseline (--corpus-role identity_baseline)
